Peptide length histogram faceted by Condition

Source: R/plots.R
plot_peplength_hist.Rd

Faceted histogram of peptide lengths across conditions, with bars coloured by whether each length falls within shortpep_range ("X to Y AAs") or outside ("others"). Replaces the plot_peplength_dens() + lapply + ggarrange approach in the report with a single facet_wrap call.

Usage

plot_peplength_hist(
  input,
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
  type = c("density", "count"),
  palette = NULL,
  xlimits = c(5, 25)
)

Arguments

input

A pep_all-shaped data frame with Length and Condition columns. Typically pep_all_unique (one row per peptide–condition pair).

shortpep_range

Length-2 integer vector giving the inclusive range [min, max] that defines the "in-range" fill category. Default c(8, 13).

type

One of "density" (y-axis = relative frequency) or "count" (y-axis = raw count). Matched via match.arg().

palette

Named character vector of length 2 mapping the range label ("X to Y AAs") and "others" to colours. When NULL, falls back to ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d().

xlimits

Length-2 numeric vector for the x-axis limits. Default c(5, 25).

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_peplength_hist(pep_all_unique, shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
                    type = "density", palette = c("8 to 13 AAs" = "#fde725",
                                                   others = "#440154"))
} # }
